linkedin.about: I design footbridges and small public buildings. I am direct and honest about risk, and I value people who say what they mean. I climb most weekends and I need to get outside to think clearly. Looking for someone who will happily get up at 5am for a sunrise summit.

posts.caption: Sent my project at the quarry today. Dry humour optional, tea mandatory.

Weekend hike with the crew, then a long cosy pub lunch.
